questions.q: I ___ to Paris three times.
questions.expl: Рассказываем об опыте без точного времени → Present Perfect (have been). Слово «three times» не указывает конкретный момент в прошлом.
wrong: Past Simple нужен, когда есть точное время (last year, in 2019).
Was going — процесс в прошлом, а не опыт.
Am going — будущее/настоящее, не подходит к «three times».

questions.q: She ___ here since 2019.
questions.expl: since + точка во времени → Present Perfect (has lived): действие началось в прошлом и продолжается сейчас.
wrong: Present Simple не сочетается с since.
Past Simple означает, что она здесь уже не живёт.
Present Continuous не используется с since для длительного состояния.

questions.q: We ___ the report yesterday.
questions.expl: yesterday — конкретное время в прошлом. С ним нельзя использовать Present Perfect, только Past Simple.
wrong: Present Perfect не используется с yesterday / last week / in 2010.
Present Simple — регулярные действия, не прошлое.

questions.q: ___ Moon orbits ___ Earth.
questions.expl: Уникальные в своём роде объекты (the Moon, the Earth, the Sun) используются с the.
wrong: A/an — для одного из многих, а Луна единственная.

questions.q: She is ___ honest woman.
questions.expl: Выбор a/an зависит от звука, а не буквы. «Honest» начинается с гласного звука /ɒ/ (h не читается) → an.
wrong: A — перед согласным звуком, а здесь h немая.
The — о конкретной, уже известной женщине.
Перед исчисляемым существительным в ед. числе артикль нужен.

questions.q: I love ___ music.
questions.expl: Когда говорим о чём-то в общем (неисчисляемое/мн. число), артикль не нужен.
wrong: The — о конкретной музыке, но здесь вообще о музыке.
An — music неисчисляемое, да и начинается на согласный.

questions.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.expl: Первый тип условных: If + Present Simple, will + V. После if будущее время не используется.
wrong: Past Simple — это уже второй тип (нереальное).

questions.q: If I ___ you, I would study harder.
questions.expl: Второй тип: If + Past Simple, would + V. В нереальных условиях с I/he/she обычно используется were.
wrong: Was допустимо в разговорной речи, но на экзамене лучше were.

questions.q: If she had studied, she ___ the exam.
questions.expl: Третий тип (нереальное прошлое): If + Past Perfect, would have + V3.

questions.q: The bridge ___ in 1990.
questions.expl: Мост не строил сам, его строили → Passive: was/were + V3. 1990 — прошлое, значит was built.
wrong: Has built — актив, а подлежащее — не исполнитель.

questions.q: English ___ all over the world.
questions.expl: Язык «говорят» (им пользуются) → Passive Present: is/are + V3.
wrong: Speaks — актив, но язык не говорит.

questions.q: She is good ___ mathematics.
questions.expl: Устойчивое сочетание: good at + навык/предмет.
wrong: Good in — ошибка, хотя встречается в речи.

questions.q: The meeting is ___ Monday.
questions.expl: Дни недели и даты → on. Месяцы/годы → in. Точное время → at.

questions.q: He is interested ___ history.
questions.expl: Устойчивое сочетание: interested in.

questions.q: The man ___ car was stolen called the police.
questions.expl: Whose показывает принадлежность (чья машина). Who/whom заменяют человека как подлежащее/дополнение.
wrong: Who заменяет человека, но не показывает «чей».
Whom — объект, а здесь нужна принадлежность.

questions.q: This is the book ___ I told you about.
questions.expl: Для предмета в определительном придаточном: that / which.

questions.q: You ___ smoke here. It is forbidden.
questions.expl: Mustn't = запрещено. Don't have to = не обязательно (но можно). Классическая ловушка!
wrong: Don't have to — «не обязан», но разрешено.
Needn't — не нужно, но не запрещено.

questions.q: You ___ wear a uniform; it is optional.
questions.expl: «Это по желанию» → don't have to (нет обязанности).

questions.q: The number of students ___ increasing.
questions.expl: The number of + мн. число → глагол в единственном (говорим о «числе»). A number of → глагол во мн. числе.
wrong: Are — было бы правильно после «A number of».

questions.q: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
questions.expl: Neither of формально требует единственного числа: is.
wrong: Are — разговорный вариант, но экзамен проверяет правило.

questions.q: He said he ___ tired.
questions.expl: В косвенной речи после said время «сдвигается назад»: is → was.

questions.q: This exam is ___ than the last one.
questions.expl: Длинные прилагательные (3+ слога): more + adj + than.

questions.q: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.expl: Превосходная степень от good → the best.

questions.q: She suggested ___ a taxi.
questions.expl: После suggest используется герундий: suggest + V-ing.

questions.q: I look forward to ___ you.
questions.expl: В look forward to — это предлог, поэтому дальше идёт герундий.

questions.q: Urban beekeeping is now more common than it used to be.
questions.expl: В тексте: «once a curiosity, has grown into a popular hobby» → раньше это было редкостью, теперь распространено. Смысл совпадает → True.
questions.key: once a curiosity, has grown into a popular hobby

questions.q: Honeybees are currently in danger of extinction.
questions.expl: В тексте прямо: «Honeybees are not endangered». Утверждение противоречит тексту → False.
wrong: Информация есть и она противоречит утверждению.

questions.q: Urban beekeepers earn more money from honey than rural farmers do.
questions.expl: В тексте нет ничего о доходах. Ловушка: тема пчёл знакома, но конкретно эта информация не упомянута → Not Given.

questions.q: What do researchers recommend for people who want to help pollinators?
opts: Plant native flowers and leave bare soil
questions.expl: Последнее предложение: «plant native flowers and leave patches of bare soil for solitary bees instead of simply buying a hive».
wrong: Исследователи говорят «instead of simply buying a hive».
questions.key: plant native flowers and leave patches of bare soil

questions.q: What is the writer's main purpose in the text?
opts: To show that a popular trend may have drawbacks
To explain how honey is made
questions.expl: Сначала плюсы, потом «However ... hidden cost» → автор показывает, что популярный тренд имеет обратную сторону.
wrong: О производстве мёда нет ни слова.
questions.key: However, some ecologists warn that the trend has a hidden cost

questions.q: Information moves to long-term memory mainly while we are awake.
questions.expl: В тексте: информация переносится в долговременную память во время сна. Утверждение противоречит → False.
questions.key: moves information from short-term to long-term memory

questions.q: The volunteers who slept remembered about 40 per cent more word pairs.
questions.expl: «nearly 40 per cent more pairs» ≈ about 40 per cent → True. «Nearly» и «about» — синонимичные приближения.

questions.q: A 20-minute nap greatly improves long-term memory.
questions.expl: Нап улучшил бодрость (alertness), но «little effect on long-term memory». Утверждение противоречит → False.
questions.key: had little effect on long-term memory

questions.q: Students who sleep more get higher exam grades.
questions.expl: Текст говорит о запоминании пар слов, но про оценки на экзаменах ничего нет → Not Given. Не додумывайте!

questions.q: Which heading best fits the second paragraph (starting “During sleep…”)?
opts: The benefits of long study nights
questions.expl: Абзац объясняет, как мозг во сне переносит информацию в долговременную память → «How sleep helps memory». Остальные заголовки охватывают только деталь или тему, которой нет.
questions.key: it replays the events of the day and moves information

questions.q: How much do students pay for annual membership?
questions.expl: Ключ: «Students pay twelve pounds a year instead of twenty». Ловушка: £20 — цена для обычных читателей.
questions.key: Students pay twelve pounds a year instead of twenty

questions.q: Which document is NOT accepted as proof of address?
questions.expl: Ключ: «but not a phone bill». Слово «not» легко пропустить — на Listening внимательно слушайте отрицания.

questions.q: What time does the library close on Saturdays?
questions.expl: Ловушка-самоисправление: «six as it says on the website. That's an error» → правильно five. 8 — это будни.
questions.key: we close at five, not six as it says on the website

questions.q: When will the caller visit the library?
questions.expl: Ключ: «I'll come on Saturday morning».

questions.q: What is the main trigger for bird migration?
questions.expl: Ключ: «the main trigger is the shortening of daylight». Cold weather — распространённое заблуждение, лектор его опровергает.
questions.key: the main trigger is the shortening of daylight

questions.q: How far does the Arctic tern travel each year?
questions.expl: «roughly seventy thousand kilometres» = 70,000 km. Тренируйтесь различать seventeen / seventy.
wrong: Этот вариант не подходит по смыслу — сверь с правилом выше.

questions.q: How heavy are the light sensors?
questions.expl: «weighing less than a gram».

questions.q: What is the topic of next week's seminar?
questions.expl: Последняя фраза: «how birds navigate using the Earth's magnetic field».
questions.key: how birds navigate using the Earth's magnetic field

questions.q: Solar panels have become far cheaper over the past decade. ___, many households still hesitate to install them because of the upfront cost.
questions.expl: Между предложениями противопоставление: дешевле, но всё ещё колеблются → However. В SAT сначала определите логику связи: контраст / следствие / пример / добавление.
wrong: For instance — пример, а здесь не пример.

questions.q: The museum's new exhibit attracted record crowds. ___, ticket revenue rose by 30 percent.
questions.expl: Рост выручки — следствие большого числа посетителей → As a result.

questions.q: Dr. Lee's early work focused on coastal erosion. ___, her later research examined river systems.
questions.expl: Связь по времени: сначала ранняя работа, затем поздняя → Subsequently («позже»).

questions.q: The experiment failed ___ the researchers had miscalculated the temperature.
questions.expl: Нужно соединить следствие и причину. because — подчинительный союз, перед ним запятая не нужна. Запятая без союза — comma splice; точка с запятой не ставится перед подчинительным союзом.
wrong: Comma splice — два предложения через запятую.
Точка с запятой + because — ошибка: после ; идёт самостоятельное предложение.

questions.q: The scientist, along with her two assistants, ___ the results yesterday.
questions.expl: Вставка «along with ...» не меняет число подлежащего: The scientist — единственное. И «yesterday» требует Past Simple.
wrong: Have — множественное число и Present Perfect.

questions.q: The ___ new policy was welcomed by employees.
questions.expl: Принадлежность одной компании → company's (ед. число + 's).
wrong: Множественное число — нужно было бы companies'.

questions.q: The author's tone is ___ rather than sarcastic; she sincerely praises the mayor.
questions.expl: Ключ: «sincerely praises» → искренний = genuine. Подсказка в самом предложении всегда есть.

questions.q: Although the plan seemed ___ at first, it soon proved impractical.
questions.expl: Although = контраст. «Impractical» ← противоположность «feasible» (выполнимый).
wrong: Absurd не создаёт контраста с impractical.

questions.q: Which choice is the most concise and clear?
opts: Due to the fact that it was raining, we stayed home.
Because it was raining, we stayed home.
The reason we stayed home was because of the rain.
It was raining, which was why we stayed home.
questions.expl: SAT любит краткость без потери смысла. «Due to the fact that» → because.

questions.q: Walking through the park, ___
opts: the flowers were beautiful to Maya.
the flowers caught her eye as the wind blew.
a bench was where Maya sat.
questions.expl: Причастный оборот должен относиться к подлежащему-человеку, который «walks». Только Maya гуляла. В остальных вариантах — dangling modifier.

questions.q: If 3x + 5 = 20, what is the value of x?
A line passes through (0, 2) and (3, 8). What is its slope?
wrong: Этот вариант не подходит по смыслу — сверь с правилом выше.

questions.q: Which are the solutions of x² − 5x + 6 = 0?
questions.expl: Разложим: (x − 2)(x − 3) = 0 → x = 2 или 3. Проверка: 2·3 = 6, 2+3 = 5.

questions.q: A jacket costs $80 and is discounted by 25%. What is the sale price?
questions.expl: Скидка 25% = 80 × 0,25 = 20. Цена = 80 − 20 = $60. (Ловушка: $20 — это сама скидка.)

questions.q: What is 15% of 240?
If x + y = 10 and x − y = 2, what is x?
questions.expl: Сложим уравнения: 2x = 12 → x = 6. Тогда y = 4.
wrong: Не подходит: 8 − y = 2 → y = 6, но тогда x + y = 14.

questions.q: If f(x) = 2x² − 3, what is f(3)?
questions.expl: f(3) = 2·3² − 3 = 2·9 − 3 = 18 − 3 = 15. Порядок: сначала степень, затем умножение.

questions.q: In a class, the ratio of boys to girls is 3:2. If there are 30 students, how many are girls?
questions.expl: Всего частей 3 + 2 = 5. Одна часть = 30 ÷ 5 = 6. Девочек 2 части = 12.

questions.q: What is the mean of 4, 8, 12 and 16?
questions.expl: Mean = сумма ÷ количество = (4+8+12+16)/4 = 40/4 = 10.

questions.q: What is 2³ · 2⁴ in simplest form?
questions.expl: При умножении степеней с одинаковым основанием показатели складываются: 2³·2⁴ = 2⁷.

questions.q: If y = 3x − 2, what is y when x = 4?
A right triangle has legs 6 and 8. What is the length of its hypotenuse?
questions.expl: Теорема Пифагора: c² = 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100 → c = 10.

passages.title: The Return of the Urban Beehive
passages.text:
Over the past decade, cities from London to Moscow have seen an unexpected newcomer on their rooftops: the honeybee. Urban beekeeping, once a curiosity, has grown into a popular hobby, with thousands of hives now sitting on office blocks, hotels and even museums.

Supporters argue that city bees often do better than their countryside cousins. Gardens and parks provide a wide range of flowers that bloom at different times, while intensive farming in rural areas can leave bees with only a single crop to feed on. Cities also tend to use fewer pesticides.

However, some ecologists warn that the trend has a hidden cost. Honeybees are not endangered, and large numbers of them may compete with wild pollinators such as bumblebees for limited food. A study of one large park found that wild bee numbers fell in areas close to new hives. Researchers therefore suggest that people who wish to help pollinators should plant native flowers and leave patches of bare soil for solitary bees instead of simply buying a hive.

passages.title: Sleep and Learning
passages.text:
For many students, an all-night study session before an exam feels like a sign of dedication. Sleep scientists, however, argue that it is one of the least effective ways to prepare.

During sleep, the brain does not simply rest; it replays the events of the day and moves information from short-term to long-term memory. This process is strongest during the deep stages of sleep early in the night, and is further supported by dreaming later on.

In one experiment, two groups of volunteers learned a list of word pairs. One group slept for eight hours, while the other stayed awake for the same period. When tested twelve hours later, the sleepers remembered nearly 40 per cent more pairs. Interestingly, a short afternoon nap of around twenty minutes also improved alertness, although it had little effect on long-term memory. The researchers concluded that students should treat sleep as part of their revision timetable rather than as time taken away from it.

listening.title: Library membership (phone call)
listening.text:
Receptionist: Good morning, City Library. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, I'd like to join the library.
Receptionist: Certainly. Is it for yourself?
Caller: Yes. I'm a student at the university, so I think I get a discount?
Receptionist: That's right. Students pay twelve pounds a year instead of twenty. You'll need to bring proof of your address.
Caller: Is a bank statement okay?
Receptionist: A bank statement is fine, or a utility bill, but not a phone bill.
Caller: Great. And what time do you close?
Receptionist: We're open until eight on weekdays, but on Saturdays we close at five, not six as it says on the website. That's an error we're fixing.
Caller: Perfect, I'll come on Saturday morning.
Receptionist: Lovely. See you then.

listening.title: Seminar: bird migration
listening.text: Welcome to today's seminar on bird migration. Many people believe that birds fly south simply because it gets cold. In fact, the main trigger is the shortening of daylight, which changes the birds' hormones. Cold weather alone doesn't cause migration; some birds leave even when the weather is still warm. The Arctic tern makes the longest journey, travelling roughly seventy thousand kilometres a year between the Arctic and Antarctic. Researchers track them using tiny light sensors weighing less than a gram. Next week we'll look at how birds navigate using the Earth's magnetic field.
